description: Human/JSON parity contract for the vlab CLI (FR-GIT-06; ADR-0015 phase 0b, issue #11 item 5). Each command entry names the JSON members its human rendering must present and the members it deliberately does not. test/conformance.test.js runs every entry against the real CLI; see README.md for the match rules and the scenario stages.

commands.name: merge-plan
commands.note: The reconciliation plan is the decision automation acts on: which changes are covered, which are heuristic candidates, and which are new.

jsonOnly.reason: The schema identifier is a machine dispatch key; the heading names the plan for a reader.
Exact-state tree identity is a machine comparison; the reader is told whether the states match, not which trees.
As targetTree.
The reader gets shortCommit; the full OID is the machine form of the same value.

commands.name: receipts
commands.note: Published causal records. The first record of this scenario is the reconciliation application.

jsonOnly.reason: Machine dispatch key; the record heading names the type for a reader.
The commit the target was on before applying is recoverable from the application chain and is not part of the reader's decision.
Tree identity is a machine equality check.
As sourceTree.
The worktree-private operation id is an internal join key; the operation itself is reported by 'vlab reconcile --status'.

commands.name: metadata-status
commands.note: The repository-wide metadata inventory, including quarantine counts and diagnostics.

jsonOnly.reason: Machine dispatch key.
The notes ref is fixed for the tool; 'vlab doctor' reports it for automation.
The lineage algorithm is versioned in the id's own contract; the reader needs the identity, not its derivation.
The full trust disclaimer is summarized on the integrity line; the sentence itself is documentation, not state.
The reader gets code and subject on one line; the long message is available in JSON for tooling that renders detail.

commands.name: metadata-validate
commands.note: Shares the status renderer; the distinct member is the validity verdict that sets the exit code.

jsonOnly.reason: Machine dispatch key.

jsonOnly.reason: The status is worktree-private by construction, so the path is the caller's own; automation that needs it has it in JSON.
Operation timestamps are audit data; the reader needs the resumable state, not when it began.

jsonOnly.reason: The signature algorithm is versioned inside the signature's own contract.
